name: hattrick-archive
description: Fetch, store, and browse a Hattrick team's match history via the CHPP API.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace server && node qa/run-web-tests.mjs && node --test qa/correct-stored-cup-winners.test.mjs scripts/*.test.mjs
scripts.qa: npm run build --workspace server && node qa/run-audit.mjs
